divergences.expected: Pans and zooms dispatch with the literal coalesce key 'crop'.
divergences.found: src/ui/SpreadView.tsx uses a per-gesture key `crop:${e.timeStamp}` for pan/pinch and `crop:wheel:${timeStamp}` per 400 ms wheel burst; src/ui/CellToolbar.tsx uses `crop:zoom:${performance.now()}` per slider movement. src/state/store.ts:25 says 'A run of dispatches with one key is one undo step', so a fixed 'crop' key would merge consecutive separate crop gestures into one undo step; the per-gesture keys make one gesture one undo step.
divergences.plan_quote: "Pans and zooms dispatch with `coalesce: 'crop'`." and the completion criterion "In crop mode, a drag of 100 px to the left gives `cx > 0.5` ... and one Ctrl+Z restores it." The keys keep the 'crop' namespace and coalesce each pan or zoom gesture, which is what the one-Ctrl+Z criterion needs.

divergences.expected: Every Phase 5 case runs on both Playwright projects.
divergences.found: tests/e2e/crop.spec.ts:62 skips the wheel-zoom/double-click/Escape case on mobile-webkit ('Playwright mobile WebKit has no mouse wheel'). The slider-never-below-1 case and the pan/Ctrl+Z case do run on mobile-webkit.
divergences.plan_quote: Decision Log: "A double-click or double-tap starts crop mode, where a drag pans, the wheel or a pinch zooms, and Escape ends it." The wheel is the desktop input; the criterion only requires the case to be in the tests and Playwright to exit 0 on both projects, which it does (21 passed, 1 skipped).

divergences.expected: The mobile tap-to-place test taps (touch pointer) photo-land-2.jpg and cell-1-0.
divergences.found: tests/e2e/dnd.spec.ts:70-71 uses locator.click() on both projects, which Playwright sends as mouse events even on iPhone 13. The touch branch of startDrag (250 ms long-press timer, src/ui/dnd.ts:1355 in bundle) is never exercised by any e2e test; mouseDrag also uses page.mouse on mobile-webkit. Tap-to-place itself uses onClick in Thumb and CellBox, so the same handlers run for a real tap.
